style: Paint it in exactly the same style as the last reference image (a painting from this same card game): the same painterly brushwork, soft cosmic light, gentle glow and luminous colour, the same level of finish. A storybook-mythic space fantasy, calm and wondrous, not gritty: no photorealism, no film-still or blockbuster superhero look, no dramatic hero line-up pose.
race: The four Lost Races, drawn exactly as in the first four reference images (each image shows three of one race), keeping their shapes, proportions, costumes and colours, only painted. The Nyxari: tall, thin hooded figures in deep indigo-black cloaks that fray into smoke at the hem, the hood empty and dark but for two pale slit eyes; some with a thorn crown and an eclipse behind the head. The Korrath: short, broad, stocky smiths entirely in polished steel plate with bronze trim, a bucket helm with a glowing T-shaped visor slit, a braided copper-red beard, a forge-heart glowing orange through the chest, a dark red cape; with forge hammers, round-bossed bronze-trimmed shields, tongs and anvils. Not stone, not orcs, no exposed faces. The Seren: tall, serene astronomers in long pale white-and-silver robes whose hem is deep navy embroidered with constellations, a white hood framing a dark face full of stars with closed, calm eyes, a great white crescent moon behind the head, small moons orbiting them; holding orreries, golden star-pointers or crescent-topped staves. Not blue-skinned, not elves. The Pyrr: living flames shaped like slender dancers, legs and body of red, orange and yellow fire, a mane of flame, eyes like glowing coals.
framing: Wide 16:9 landscape. The painted scene fills the whole picture edge to edge: its sky or background continues right up to the top edge, with open sky across the top quarter (never a flat colour band, blank strip, letterbox bar, border or frame). The main figure's head sits about 40% of the way down and a little to one side of centre, never at the very top; keep faces and key details away from the bottom centre of the picture. The painting runs right to the bottom edge with no emblem, seal, logo, line or border anywhere. No text, no lettering.

cards.mode_lost_races: A quiet, wondrous meeting on a small grassy-dark moon under a vast swirling violet and ember nebula: one figure of each Lost Race stands loosely around a small glowing forge-anvil and a floating orrery, as if gathering after a long journey, seen at a little distance so the cosmic sky is large above them; a Korrath smith resting a hammer on the anvil, a Seren astronomer raising a tiny orrery of moons, a Pyrr flame-dancer mid-twirl casting warm light, a Nyxari hooded stalker half in shadow at the edge. A big pale crescent moon and a dim red sun hang in the sky. Gentle, mysterious, inviting.
